title: Mergers and Acquisitions
overview: This hands-on course provides a comprehensive understanding of the Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) process, from valuing shares to finalizing the deal. Whether or not participants are directly involved in M&A activities, this course offers an insider’s perspective on this influential aspect of today’s corporate landscape.

Participants will gain an end-to-end understanding of the M&A process, enabling them to assess whether a merger or acquisition aligns with their organization’s strategy. By the end, they will be able to identify the most promising M&A opportunities, select optimal partners, and maximize the value derived from deals
audience: This course is ideal for individuals involved in identifying, planning, or executing M&A opportunities, including: CEOs, managing directors, general managers, financial directors, accountants, board members, commercial directors, business development directors, strategy planners and analysts, and in-house legal counsel.
methodology: This interactive course involves a blend of pair work, group exercises, and case studies from both regional and international contexts to reinforce learning and apply concepts in real-world scenarios.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Formulate initial steps and preliminary agreements for a merger or acquisition.
Conduct a thorough due diligence process on a target company.
Understand the key elements of the Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) and the Asset Purchase Agreement (APA).
Play an active role in the exchange and completion phases of a merger or acquisition.
Contribute to the post-merger integration process to ensure a seamless transition and operational efficiency in the new organization.
